params.1273: Sell an item to a shop.
params.1274: Travel to a store that buys the item you wish to sell.
params.1275: A general store will buy anything that can be sold, but at a reduced price.
params.1276: Open the shop interface, right-click the item and choose to sell however many you wish.
params.2225: Selling unwanted goods to a general store is a quick way of turning them into useful cash. A shop that stocks that specific item will give you more for it, however. When you do creative or gathering skills like Fishing, Crafting or Fletching, you may end up with a stockpile of extra items. Selling these items to a shop is the perfect way to make a quick coin!
